structures.name: SIMCONNECT_DATA_INITPOSITION
structures.description: Defines the initial position and orientation used to place an aircraft or object in the simulation world. This structure is used with SimConnect_SetDataOnSimObject and AI creation functions to set a complete 6-degree-of-freedom starting state.

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: Latitude of the position in decimal degrees. Positive values are north of the equator; negative values are south. Valid range is -90.0 to +90.0.

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: Longitude of the position in decimal degrees. Positive values are east of the prime meridian; negative values are west. Valid range is -180.0 to +180.0.

fields.name: Altitude
fields.description: Altitude above mean sea level in feet. The aircraft is placed at this MSL altitude regardless of terrain elevation at the specified latitude and longitude.

fields.name: Pitch
fields.description: Pitch angle in degrees. Positive values represent nose-up pitch; negative values represent nose-down pitch. Valid range is -90.0 to +90.0.

fields.name: Bank
fields.description: Bank (roll) angle in degrees. Positive values represent a right-wing-down (clockwise when viewed from behind) bank; negative values represent a left-wing-down bank. Valid range is -180.0 to +180.0.

fields.name: Heading
fields.description: True heading in degrees. The direction the aircraft nose points, measured clockwise from true north. Valid range is 0.0 to 360.0.

fields.name: OnGround
fields.description: Specifies whether the aircraft should be placed on the ground surface. Set to 1 to place on the ground (the simulator will adjust altitude to the ground elevation); set to 0 to use the Altitude field as specified.

fields.name: Airspeed
fields.description: Initial indicated airspeed in knots. The aircraft is given this airspeed at placement. Set to 0 to place the aircraft stationary.

structures.remarks: When OnGround is set to 1 the Altitude field is ignored and the simulator places the aircraft on the terrain surface at the specified latitude and longitude. All angular values use degrees, not radians.

structures.name: SIMCONNECT_RECV
structures.description: Base header structure that begins every message packet received from the SimConnect server. All SIMCONNECT_RECV_* structures begin with the fields defined here, allowing the client to determine the message type and size before casting to the appropriate specific type.

fields.name: dwSize
fields.description: Total size of the complete received structure in bytes, including this header and any variable-length data appended at the end of specific packet types.

fields.name: dwVersion
fields.description: SimConnect protocol version number of the server that sent this packet. Clients can use this to detect version mismatches between the client library and the simulator.

fields.name: dwID
fields.description: Identifies the type of received message. This value is one of the SIMCONNECT_RECV_ID enumeration values and determines which SIMCONNECT_RECV_* structure the packet should be cast to.

structures.remarks: All receive packet handlers should begin by reading dwID from this base structure to determine the packet type. The dwSize field must be checked before accessing variable-length fields to avoid buffer overruns.
